notes.title: Roguelike Celebration + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Roguelike Celebration Updates[/h2]
We're excited to announce that dev_hell has been selected for Roguelike Celebration 2024! We've updated the demo with even more features and fixes in time for the festival.

[h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clicking on any unplayable card will tell you exactly why it's unplayable
[*] "Hand Full" indicator when you are at max hand size (10 cards)
[*] Coffee Refills are now reward options in certain dialogues
[*] More lighting + sound effects to illustrate how cards are interacting on the board 
[*] Improved clarity on card output destination, both before and after play
[*] Randomized reasons provided when you're fired
[/list]
[h3]UPDATED SYSTEMS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smoother transitions between encounters and character animations (ongoing progress)
[*] More cards displayed at once when scrolling on the end-of-game summary screen
[*] Improvements to visual culling settings to reduce stuttering when turning around
[*] Scheduling-chips on features have clearer representation of current progress
[*] Clean camera motion in all instances of getting fired
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prevent code and reputation meter-inputs from sometimes becoming invisible
[*] Kyle can now return to his chair properly after leaving his desk 
[*] Disabled interactions with CodeMonkey tabs when screen is locked
[*] Correct number of total comments for Code Review on conference room TV
[*] Fix reputation meter not relocking when ending a match with reputation unlocked
[*] Using DEPLOY against a shield will now reduce the shield as expected
[*] Resolve logical effects on all cards after a Buffer Overflow
[/list]
[h3]Join Us On Discord![/h3]
Find sneak peaks for upcoming content, learn strategy tips, provide feedback on gameplay, and report any bugs you might see so we can make create the best experience possible!

[url=https://discord.gg/jYwyDDFPc6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/483c7fc604dd1f14777ec9ab7e3ac944fa70d1e1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Phase 2 Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Phase 2 Demo Now Available[/h2]

We’re excited to announce the second version of the dev_hell demo is live! This update brings major upgrades to all game systems as well as many new hours of content. Phase 2 will generate more than enough content for multiple runs, but even more replay-ability is on the way! Leading up to the release, we’ll be continuing to add even more content to provide players trying out our demo with the fullest experience of the game so far.

[h3]SPRINT 1 + 2[/h3]
After completing the tutorial, subsequent runs will kickoff Phase 1 of Sprint 1. After successfully finishing the first sprint, you will unlock Sprint 2, which will feature two entirely new encounter types: Collaboration  + Launch. In the full game, every sprint will evolve over time as you delve further and further down the rabbit hole.

[h3]COMPANY SWAG[/h3]
New items have been introduced that can dramatically change the way you play and create a variety of interesting and powerful combos. There are 25 total items in the demo with many, many more planned! The first sprint will start off with a choice of company swag so that every run can start in a unique way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/54de4b7fb7ba5768914e5bd4c3addce01400287f.png[/img]

[h3]CLEARER ROUTING PREVIEWS[/h3]
Over the course of our playtesting so far, we've received a lot of feedback on better ways to indicate whether cards are about to output or not. Routes are now displayed in a more intuitive way, utilizing both colors and active connections to help convey the exact interactions each card will make on the board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/f27a297ebfc82c47bbc47633afe4676890df4fab.png[/img]

[h3]NEW ENCOUNTERS[/h3]
Launch your first app [b]or die trying[/b]! The final encounter of Sprint 2 will require you to see your work through to the end, or else… Will the app’s release manage to go off without a hitch? [b]The pressure is on![/b]
To ensure maximum efficiency, there is also an opportunity to collaborate with your coworkers to create synergies during launch based on your current relations. As we all know, building up social credit with your colleagues is an essential part of the job!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/a0dec176ca2a4a996f7b448382e2c2942ba31b70.png[/img]

[h3]FULLY-STOCKED COMPANY STORE[/h3]
All items are now available in the store. In addition to the 3 snack slots that were previously available, the store will now also carry random company swag, a random card mod and a rare card mod. Some of these items can be very expensive so you’ll have to make sure you’re saving up your kudos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/eb997b15f91d13414d8c153123e77e8ee77b8910.png[/img]

[h3]TUTORIAL OVERHAULS[/h3]
Thanks to the people who have provided feedback and continued to test with us, we've introduced new tutorials and enhanced the clarity of existing tutorials! The tutorial for the first sprint will include more fixed rewards to help you build your first deck successfully while you’re still picking up the mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/1944fe0996bf94a7c0416cd66faf16c646cfd1c8.png[/img]

[h3]CONTENT UPDATED[/h3]
Over 40 new cards, 8 new card mods, and many new encounters are now available! All characters are animated and gameplay mechanics feature a multitude of visual and sound effects. Balance updates and general improvements across the difficulty curve, based on extensive playtesting, have been implemented to improve game feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/c531d02f6459e265ac94ceae4326a4dd75a3eafa.png[/img]

[h3]PERFORMANCE SETTINGS[/h3]
Tweaks have been made to various settings in order to improve performance, including texture resolution as well as an option to disable the coffee liquid simulation (*which has been the only source of crashing we've seen so far).

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
Tons of bugs have been fixed — but if you still see something, say something! There's an anonymous feedback form in the game; otherwise you are welcome to jump into our Discord if you would like to message us directly. We’re trying our best to ensure a bug-free experience and welcome all feedback!

[h3]STAY TUNED![/h3]
In our next update, we'll be adding more interactions related to coworker relations, new side stories to explore, as well as more in-depth interactions with the company Smack. Deck-building options for duplicating, deleting and modifying cards will also be introduced as a mechanic through specific encounters. 

And of course: there will be more content, cards, items, and mods coming soon! These will include cards that can even change and influence other cards on the board.

[h2]JOIN US ON DISCORD![/h2]
See sneak peaks at upcoming content, help with balance feedback, and report any bugs you see so we can make sure the experience is as good as possible!

[url=https://discord.gg/jYwyDDFPc6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/483c7fc604dd1f14777ec9ab7e3ac944fa70d1e1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Phase 1 Demo Patch Notes!
notes.content:
[h2]Phase 1.1 Update![/h2]

We've updated our demo with tons of new cards, card mods, features, and fixes. If you haven't played yet, it's a good time to check out and try the tutorial! 

The Phase 2 Demo will be coming up next, which will include the second act of the game as well as a non-tutorialized version of the first act. Company swag (relics) will also become available, which will provide powerful effects that you can build your deck around.  This phase should provide several hours of gameplay with a deeper dive into the dev_hell experience.

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
We've added new speed options for navigating through the game. You can choose to take your time and smell the toner or jump instantly between encounters:

[list]
[*] Normal — Walk around between encounters, click to speed up
[*] Fast — Always speed up time when possible, but don't skip anything
[*] Warp — Skip most walking and speed up time everywhere else
[/list]
[h3]GAMEPLAY AND FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intro screen with control overview for first time players.
[*] Select speed for card game (1x, 2x, 3x)
[*] Staged issues that are about to output on the next turn will display a light under the values that will output.
[*] Improved visibility of how much concentration or inspiration is required to play a card (esp. if you don’t have enough). 
[*] Debugging screen adequately warns you of increased risk.
[*] TV in conference room will be fully functional during code review.
[*] Small pip on any card mods that are installed by player (vs by default).
[*] Concentration cards are more common in random loot pools.
[*] Several usability improvements have been introduced to code review: 
[list]
[*] Highlight cards in comment by hovering the comment.
[*] Hover cards in comments in order to see the actual card.
[*] Clearer indicators of when comments are complete/incomplete/about to expire.
[/list][/list]
[h3]NEW CONTENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] 32 new and reworked cards!
[*] 22 new card mods — 19 of which can be used to customize cards!
[*] Many new special effects and sounds during card matches!
[*] More flavor text and tooltips!
[*] More animations and interactions between characters! (mainly for Lydia, Kyle, Griffen, and Sophie)
[*] Plenty of balancing and card mod reward updates — this is an ongoing effort as we collect more and more player feedback!
[/list]

Make sure to stay tuned for an announcement in the near future… Phase 2 Demo is coming soon!

notes.title: Phase 1 Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Phase 1 Demo Now Available![/b]

Today we released the first stage of our demo, where you can experience the game’s tutorial and begin to learn the mechanics of dev_hell. Playtime for a run of the demo should range approximately 20-40 minutes, although more time may be necessary for a successful playthrough (i.e. managing to avoid [i]termination[/i] for poor job “performance”). 

Coming soon, we will be introducing additional demo content: most notably a second act, as well as a progressed, non-tutorialized version of the first act! Our goal with the full demo is to provide several hours of replayable content and allow you to get a real feel for the office before the game’s release this summer.

Let us know what you think either on Steam, [url=https://discord.com/invite/KmaHa2hwAd]Discord[/url], or by filling out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/13yHbZ939elmusCWpkR35hXhaxPMbCXKRUWdUSobj1Js]feedback form[/url]. We’d love to hear your thoughts!

Thanks for playing! The company appreciates your contributions (:

notes.title: hello world
notes.content:
[h3]THE BASICS [/h3]
At [b]CodeNOW[/b] we expect all of our employees to have a strong understanding of the fundamentals of software development. In addition to coding skills, however, you must also possess excellent communication and focus. This handbook will outline all expectations in relation to these concepts.

[h3]FOCUS[/h3]
In order to deploy effective solutions and communicate clearly, an engineer needs to be able to clearly concentrate. Concentration will allow you to deploy solutions to resolve issues. There are many ways to generate concentration:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/e09caec159a82a690daa48eb555bc411952f9a71.png[/img]

From time to time we will also expect our employees to be inspired and accomplish great feats of engineering. The [i][b]inspiration[/b][/i] requirements are covered in a subsequent section of this handbook.

[h3]CODE[/h3]
Finishing your tasks, debugging and completing features will all require you to code. Having your features completed by the end of each sprint will help you avoid [i]major[/i] consequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/4eb1e013c4f36b4158f43b79a9abcd6f3dc3c5f4.png[/img]

[h3]INFLUENCE[/h3]
To ensure clear communication and the necessity of certain coding tasks, you must use the [i][b]influence[/b][/i] of your position. If negative influence goes unanswered it may affect your reputation and eventually your employment status at [b]CodeNOW[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/285b3cd51666c0aeb56f423aa6182e656d0c148f.png[/img]

[h3]AVOIDING FAILURE[/h3]
Should any issue reach -1 or less code or influence, it will be [i]resolved[/i]. It is your goal to resolve as many issues this way as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801660/948f5f86c00eba32e71975d96bed085647fcdf15.png[/img]

[h3]FINDING SUCCESS[/h3]
[b]CodeNOW[/b] expects that your understanding of these fundamentals will be the foundation of your successful employment. 

[b]We look forward to working with you.[/b]

notes.title: dev_hell Official Announcement!
notes.content:
Today we officially announced dev_hell to the world. It's been in the works for a long time and we're so hyped to see that the message is resonating with people! 

Our goal: put you in the shoes of a developer juggling multiple priorities, who just wants to make it through the day. But keep in mind: everything isn't always as it seems. There may be something sinister lurking underneath the surface...

Moving forward, you can expect weekly posts from us on Steam and we will be happy to answer any questions you might have! We're excited to get to know the people interested in our game and we are dedicated to delivering a complete, quality experience with simple pricing and no monetization shenanigans (promise). 

Please leave a comment if you have any questions, otherwise we'll see you soon for [i]dev_hell: hello world[/i]

notes.title: This roguelike deckbuilder is software development meets Inscryption
notes.content:
Hey! How would you like to contribute to the downfall of society? I do so by regularly tuning into Love Island and/or Married At First Sight. For those of you who'd like to do your part in videogame form, dev_hell looks to be the answer. It's a first-person deckbuilding roguelike where you play as a software developer employed by a shady corporation to "reshape the future", and it's giving off strong whiffs of Inscryption. As much as I know dev_hell will be incredibly unsettling… I'm in.
